methodology: Production SDK. Isolated Chrome per record; alternate before/after order per repetition. Eight worker/GPU terminals, 64 fixed-width log lines per batch, fixed-count offered 12 batches/s; acknowledged bytes and achieved rate retained. No flush during load. onRender counts submissions, not GPU completion or display frames. CPU: cumulative isolated Chrome process CPU-time / wall seconds; 100% is one logical core. Process-set changes invalidate that CPU estimate. State hashes and reveal screenshot checks run outside measurement. Unrelated host applications remain running; no GPU-utilization percentage is inferred.
